done_when: Close names each changed source file that no test mentions, saying GitHub's checks will cover it, and the worker brief tells workers that when they change text the program prints they search the tests for that text and run those tests

findings.body: Raise: Not done. Close still omits the notice on normal paths. With six test files, changing three selected tests and an unmentioned source file makes `fasttest.py:328-330` return before printing the computed `gaps`. A changed shared test input takes `fasttest.py:298-300`, where `gaps` is never computed. The report can also lose notices: with 51 skip-related lines, two gap lines, and 40 lines from a later runner, `review.py:369-374` truncates both gap lines, leaving `close.py:216-217` nothing to print. The named close test covers only a small, non-skipped report and passes in these cases.
findings.title: Not done: Close names each changed source file that no test mentions, saying GitHub's checks will cover it

why: Close picks local tests only when they name or import a changed file, so tests that check a program's output from outside are missed and fail only on GitHub
